description: The companion skill for a theme, to write into the project so the agent keeps the theme's rules on every later edit without calling this server: the theme's own design skill (typography, colour, spacing, components, do and don't) plus the shared Lexington sections skill (fill, fit, reskin, port). Call once per project after the first get_sections.

target.description: Where skills live in this project. cursor: .cursor/skills/ (default). claude: .claude/skills/. agents: one AGENTS.md block to append, for clients without skills.

name: get_skill
